notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.notes:
Sorry about another update so soon, but this one is esential.

Version 1.02

Balance

Tweaked all the magical formulas to ensure lower magical damage from both heroes and enemies

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.notes:
Bugfix

The Weapon&Armor shop first opened an empty store, before prompting player to choose what to buy, this has been fixed.
Using the spell of Quantum Leap didn't leave behind return teleport, this has been fixed
Daggers above Iron Dagger had a wrong typing, causing them unable to be equiped, this has been fixed

Gameplay

Tweaked the speed of battles to make them faster
